description: One business rule, 'shipping is free when the order total is at least 50', implemented in two components with different code shapes: `total >= 50` (units) in checkout, and `!(sum < FREE_SHIPPING_MIN_CENTS)` with the constant 5000 (cents) in invoicing. No shared token sequence, no shared literal (50 vs 5000, 4.99 vs 499).

ruleDuplications.rule: Shipping is free when the order total is at least 50 (currency units); otherwise a flat fee applies.

cheapExpectation.why: Type-4 clone (different shape) and different literals; the clone and shared-literal proxies have nothing to match.

notes: Whether the invoicing site is also a misplaced responsibility (a domain rule in an application service) is debatable; it is neither expected nor forbidden.
